rationale: Held text (7 FR 7419) confirms EO 9248 is a single rewrite of Section V of EO 9240. Held EO 9601 (10 FR 10275, 1945-08-21) revokes EO 9240 as amended, effective on the date of the order, with no savings clause, so the 9248 text ended 1945-08-21 by revocation of its parent. The number search found no earlier ending, the 1989 row is only corroboration, and the gaps are honestly stated.
